spine: 1. 通用壓縮器（zstd/xz）只看到一串均質 byte，留了壓縮 gain 在桌上；OpenZL 換前提——讓使用者把資料結構講給壓縮器聽。
2. SDDL 是描述二進位格式的 DSL，把『資料的形狀』變成壓縮的一個顯式輸入；描述也可由自訂 parser + 離線 training 產生。
3. 引擎是 codec 的有向無環圖（graph model）：每個節點是可逆變換（delta、tokenize、entropy），把 redundancy 從 coder 看不見的形式搬成看得見的形式。
4. 一個壓縮器、無數格式如何成立：壓縮計畫被序列化進自描述 wire format，單一通用解壓器讀圖反推——換來安全稽核集中、fleet-wide 推進、向後相容。
5. SAO 數字：壓縮比 2.06×（zstd 1.31×、xz 1.64×），官網速度 203/822 MB/s，發表文 340/1200 MB/s（M1/clang-17）——兩組分開引，呈現同一件事：高壓縮比 + 高吞吐。
6. 為什麼重要：資料中心熱路徑容不下慢速壓縮，AI workload 是高度結構化又龐大的資料；OpenZL 把『設計壓縮策略』與『維護解壓器』拆開，開發從 months 縮到 days，已在 Meta production 大量使用。

perspective.mechanism: 首頁定位 OpenZL 為『格式感知』壓縮：用描述建專用壓縮器、共用單一通用解壓器，並給出 SAO 三方 benchmark。
perspective.tradeoff: 通用框架的可維護性 vs 專用壓縮器的表現——OpenZL 主張兩者兼得。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師看 SAO 數字判斷 OpenZL 是否值得放進自己的儲存/傳輸熱路徑。

perspective.mechanism: SDDL 是描述二進位格式的 DSL，提供 type/record/array/variable/expression 與 when/expect。
perspective.tradeoff: 要先寫描述（成本）換取下游壓縮可用結構（收益）。
perspective.reader_use: 評估替自家格式寫一份 SDDL 描述的可行性與工作量。

perspective.mechanism: compression graph 是壓縮與解壓的共同驅動；解壓不需要 --profile；profile vs trained 的壓縮比落差。
perspective.tradeoff: 現成 profile（省事）vs training（更高壓縮比但要離線探索）。
perspective.reader_use: 決定先用現成 profile 還是投入 training 取得更高壓縮比。

perspective.mechanism: README 給核心定位、core library + 工具產生專用壓縮器、單一通用解壓器、向後相容承諾。
perspective.tradeoff: 向後相容保證綁在 release-tagged 版本上（至少數年）。
perspective.reader_use: 確認成熟度（production-readiness、Meta 線上使用）與長期相容承諾再決定採用。

perspective.mechanism: 發表文解釋 format-aware 的動機與 SAO 拆解流程（split header、decompose、delta、tokenize、per-stream），並給通用解壓器三大效益與另一組 SAO 速度數字。
perspective.tradeoff: 拿通用框架換到專用壓縮器等級表現；速度數字依平台（M1/clang-17）而異。
perspective.reader_use: 理解 SAO 範例的 codec 流程與目標使用者（AI workload）。

perspective.mechanism: 白皮書提出 graph model（DAG of modular codecs）與 self-describing wire format + universal decoder 的理論框架。
perspective.tradeoff: universal decoder 消除 deployment lag；標準 component library 降低安全風險。
perspective.reader_use: 從理論層面理解為何單一解壓器能解任意配置，以及 Meta 內部 months→days 的開發收益。

notes.quote: OpenZL ... delivers high compression ratios while preserving high speed, designed for engineers managing large specialized datasets. It generates format-specific compressors from data descriptions and uses a single universal decompressor across all formats.
notes.interpretation: 首頁一句話定位：格式感知、用描述生壓縮器、單一通用解壓器。

notes.quote: Compression Ratio | 1.31x | 1.64x | 2.06x ; Compression Speed | 115 MB/s | 3.1 MB/s | 203 MB/s ; Decompression Speed | 890 MB/s | 30 MB/s | 822 MB/s
notes.interpretation: SAO 三方表：zstd -3 / xz -9 / OpenZL 的壓縮比、壓縮速度、解壓速度。

notes.quote: SDDL is a domain-specific language for describing binary file formats.
notes.interpretation: SDDL 的定義。

notes.quote: enable you to formally specify the structure of binary data so it can be efficiently processed by compression algorithms, transformation tools, and other downstream systems.
notes.interpretation: SDDL 的目的；說明它是一份說明書而非壓縮演算法。

notes.quote: SDDL users work with fundamental building blocks including types, records, arrays, variables, and expressions. They can also employ conditional logic through "when" blocks and validation constraints via "expect" statements.
notes.interpretation: SDDL 構件清單。

notes.quote: The compression graph is the ultimate driver of both compression and decompression.
notes.interpretation: graph 同時驅動壓縮與解壓。

notes.quote: Note that decompression doesn't require any --profile: data compressed with openzl is always decodable, regardless of which --profile was used for compression.
notes.interpretation: CLI 層面的通用解壓證據。

notes.quote: the sra0 sample achieved 1.50x compression with OpenZL's format-aware approach, compared to 1.22x with zstd-19 and 1.19x with gzip-9. Training improved results further to 3.47x compression. ... Training improved compression ratio by 130.48%.
notes.interpretation: sra0 樣本上 profile 1.50× vs zstd-19 1.22× vs gzip-9 1.19×，training 後 3.47×。注意這是 sra0 樣本，與 SAO 不同資料集。

notes.quote: OpenZL takes a description of your data and builds from it a specialized compressor optimized for your specific format.
notes.interpretation: 核心機制句。

notes.quote: OpenZL consists of a core library and tools to generate specialized compressors — all compatible with a single universal decompressor.
notes.interpretation: core library + 工具 + 單一通用解壓器的構成。

notes.quote: designed for engineers that deal with large quantities of specialized datasets (like AI workloads for example) and require high speed for their processing pipelines.
notes.interpretation: 目標使用者。

notes.quote: payloads compressed with any release-tagged version of the library will remain decompressible by new releases of the library for at least the next several years.
notes.interpretation: 向後相容的具體承諾。

notes.quote: Despite the big scary warnings above, we consider the core to have reached production-readiness, and OpenZL is used extensively in production at Meta.
notes.interpretation: 成熟度宣稱：production-ready、Meta 大量使用。

notes.quote: OpenZL is a new data compression framework. OpenZL offers lossless compression for structured data, with performance comparable to specialized compressors.
notes.interpretation: Meta 官方一句話定位。

notes.quote: Using generic methods on structured data leaves compression gains on the table.
notes.interpretation: 通用方法的代價。

notes.quote: Compression can then focus on a sequence of reversible steps that surface patterns before coding.
notes.interpretation: 可逆變換先攤開規律、再交給 coder。

notes.quote: The SAO example ... separate headers, decompose records into field streams, apply format-specific transforms (delta coding for sorted positions, tokenization for low-cardinality fields), then optimize each resulting stream differently.
notes.interpretation: SAO 的 codec 流程。

notes.quote: all OpenZL files can be decompressed using the same universal OpenZL decompressor (regardless of compression configuration), enabling security audits, fleet-wide improvements, and backward compatibility.
notes.interpretation: 通用解壓器三大效益。

notes.quote: On M1 CPU using clang-17: Compression ratio: 2.06x ; Compression speed: 340 MB/s ; Decompression speed: 1200 MB/s.
notes.interpretation: 發表文版 SAO：比 2.06×、壓 340 MB/s、解 1200 MB/s，平台 M1/clang-17。

notes.quote: An offline training component ... builds an effective compression config that can be re-employed for similar data.
notes.interpretation: 離線 training 環節。

notes.quote: the 'graph model' of compression, a new theoretical framework for representing compression as a directed acyclic graph of modular codecs.
notes.interpretation: graph model 的正式定義。

notes.quote: OpenZL compresses data into a self-describing wire format, any configuration of which can be decompressed by a universal decoder.
notes.interpretation: 自描述 wire format + 通用 decoder。

notes.quote: its universal decoder eliminates deployment lag; and its investment in a well-vetted standard component library minimizes security risks.
notes.interpretation: 通用 decoder 消除佈署延遲、標準 component library 降低安全風險。

notes.quote: Internal deployments at Meta have also shown consistent improvements in size and/or speed, with development timelines reduced from months to days.
notes.interpretation: Meta 內部佈署的 size/speed 改進與開發 months→days。
